description: Rename the project from 'Nexus Workflow Mind Map' to 'ThoughtFlow' across all files. ThoughtFlow best fits the product vision of a thinking canvas with lightweight task management.
steps: Step 1: In index.html, change the <title> from 'Nexus Workflow Mind Map' to 'ThoughtFlow'.
Step 2: In package.json, change the 'name' field from 'nexus-workflow-mindmap' to 'thoughtflow'.
Step 3: In src/App.jsx, update the export filename in exportData function from 'nexus-workflow-...' to 'thoughtflow-...' (around line 1860).
Step 4: In src/App.jsx, update the full backup export filename in exportAllData from 'nexus-full-backup-...' to 'thoughtflow-backup-...' (around line 1744).
Step 5: In src/App.jsx, update the partial export filename from 'nexus-partial-...' to 'thoughtflow-partial-...' (search for nexus-partial in file download name).

Step 6: Keep all localStorage keys ('nexus-app-state', 'nexus-active-project', 'nexus-default-project', 'nexus-clipboard', 'nexus-clipboard-group') UNCHANGED to avoid breaking existing user data. Only rename user-visible strings and filenames.

Step 7: In src/App.jsx, update the backup type identifier in importAllData from checking 'nexus-full-backup' to also accepting 'thoughtflow-backup' (support both for backward compatibility). Update exportAllData to use 'thoughtflow-backup' as the type.
Step 8: Do NOT change package-lock.json manually - it will be regenerated if needed.
acceptance_criteria: Full backup import accepts both 'nexus-full-backup' and 'thoughtflow-backup' types for backward compatibility
localStorage keys remain unchanged (no data loss for existing users)
npm run build succeeds without errors
